about_the_game:
Welcome to the backlands of CactusLamp, a fictional universe where rich brazilian culture collides with the dust of the Wild West. The once-peaceful Cactus Village now suffers under the iron fist of Lampião, the embodiment of Greed. Oppression reigns, and hope is but a fading memory.

Weary of the tyranny, an unlikely hero rises: Sir Cactus. For a chance to liberate his people, he strikes a perilous pact with Lampião himself: to reunite the shattered fragments of a legendary crystal. Each piece, however, is guarded by one of the other six Deadly Sins—dreaded figures spread across this unforgiving world.

Your quest will lead you on an intense 2D action-platformer journey centered on epic boss battles. Each sin you confront guards not just a crystal fragment, but a definitive test of your abilities, requiring precision, sharp reflexes, and strategy to emerge victorious.

  • Challenge the seven deadly Sins: Face seven thematic bosses that fuse Brazilian folklore with Wild West archetypes, each protecting a fragment of the crystal;

  • High-risk combat: This is a challenge for the strong. By default, you have only one life to defeat each boss. Every move counts in a combat system that demands precision, quick reflexes, and strategy;

  • Prove your worth in 'Final Judgment' mode: For the most fearless players who complete the journey, a supreme challenge awaits. Unlock this mode and face all bosses in sequence, without rest. An extremely difficult test of endurance and skill, only for those who dare to risk it all;

  • Help the villagers: In addition to your main journey, take on side quests from the inhabitants of Cactus Village to earn rewards and delve deeper into the lore of this universe.
